newsitem.title: FRANCE: S.Africa's Mbeki meets Zaire's Mobutu in France.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Mbeki meets Zaire's Mobutu in France.

text.p: South African Vice-President Thabo Mbeki held talks on Tuesday with Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko in Nice, where the Zairean leader is recuperating from prostate cancer surgery, French officials said.

Aides made no comment on the talks but they were presumed to centre on the situation in eastern Zaire, where hundreds of thousands of refugees are threatened with death. South Africa has indicated it might join an international force to help rescue them.
Mbeki, who was scheduled to leave Nice for Rome after the meeting, arrived from Paris where he lunched with French Prime Minister Alain Juppe.
